name: EQT
description: EQT is a large US natural gas producer that also owns the pipes: a vertically integrated Appalachian Basin company that drills gas wells in Pennsylvania, West Virginia and Ohio, gathers the gas through its own pipelines, and moves it on transmission lines, including a stake in the Mountain Valley Pipeline. It sold 2,382 Bcfe of gas, NGLs and oil in 2025 at an average realized 3.19 dollars per Mcfe and holds 28.0 Tcfe of proved reserves. Upstream drilling earns most of the profit and moves with gas prices; the midstream segments earn steady fees, partly from its own upstream segment (eliminated in consolidation). Its 2025 revenue was 8.6 billion dollars and net income 2.04 billion, against 5.3 billion and 231 million in 2024. In H1 2026 net income was 1.70 billion versus 1.03 billion a year earlier, though Q2 2026 alone fell to 211 million from 784 million. Debt reduction is the stated priority (long-term goal 5.0 billion dollars), with a small dividend.

businessLines.shareBasis: 8,024 of 9,898 million total segment revenue (consolidated revenue 8,644 million after eliminating 1,254 million of intersegment transport charges)
businessLines.how: Sells gas, NGLs and oil at market-linked prices to utilities, power generators, marketers and LNG buyers; also books hedge gains and losses in revenue. Profit is price minus lifting and transport cost, so it swings with gas prices.
businessLines.description: Drilling and producing natural gas, NGLs and oil from about 2.3 million acres in the Appalachian Basin using combo-development (drilling many wells on a pad group at once); grew via the Olympus Energy acquisition (closed July 1, 2025).

businessLines.name: Gathering
businessLines.how: Fees per unit of gas gathered, largely under contracts with minimum volume commitments; most volume comes from EQT's own wells.
businessLines.description: Low-pressure and high-pressure gathering pipelines and compression collecting gas from wells to transmission lines.

businessLines.description: Interstate and intrastate transmission and storage pipelines (Equitrans, the pipeline company EQT owns) and a stake in the Mountain Valley Pipeline joint venture.
